action.old_text:
"""Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""

    raise NotImplementedError("implement the paper-core reproduction task")
action.new_text:
"""Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""

    # Validate inputs
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must not be boolean")
    if not isinstance(tau_filter, (int, float)):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a number")
    if tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be nonnegative")
    for arr, name in [(logp_with_result, "logp_with_result"), (logp_call_only, "logp_call_only"), (logp_no_call, "logp_no_call")]:
        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a numpy array")
        if arr.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be 2D")
        if arr.size == 0:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must not be empty")
        if not np.all(np.isfinite(arr)):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must contain only finite values")
        if np.any(arr > 0):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be nonpositive")
    if not (logp_with_result.shape == logp_call_only.shape == logp_no_call.shape):
        raise ValueError("all input matrices must have the same shape")
    n_candidates, future_horizon = logp_with_result.shape
    # Compute normalized weights
    t = np.arange(future_horizon)
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0, 1 - 0.2 * t)
    normalized_weights = raw_weights / np.sum(raw_weights)
    # Compute weighted losses
    loss_with = -np.sum(normalized_weights * logp_with_result, axis=1)
    loss_call = -np.sum(normalized_weights * logp_call_only, axis=1)
    loss_none = -np.sum(normalized_weights * logp_no_call, axis=1)
    # Compute baseline and margin
    baseline = np.minimum(loss_none, loss_call)
    margins = baseline - loss_with
    keep = margins >= tau_filter
    return keep, margins
